contentHtml:
Samsung Repairs Stretton

Samsung, the South Korean multinational conglomerate company is one of the leading manufacturer of wide range electronic products from household appliances up to personal and business computing devices. If you are looking for a trusted quality and affordable repair solution for your Samsung computer in Brisbane, you are in the right place.

Computer Repairs Stretton have years of experience in fixing the most common Samsung desktop and laptop problems for a fraction of the cost of buying a new one. Our mission is to be the number one provider of repair and services dedicated for Samsung computer products anywhere in Brisbane. With our expertise in the industry of computer repairs, we successfully received the most number of five-star reviews compared to other repair service provider in Australia, currently amounting to more than 200 customer reviews.

Our Samsung computer repairs Stretton service covers

Samsung DC jack repair, Does your laptop only runs when in battery? Your laptop’s DC jack is loose and won’t charge? You might need to consider a DC jack repair or a replacement.

Samsung motherboard repair, Damaged motherboard can render you Samsung computer to completely stop working. We suggest that you bring your computer to us and have our experts take a look at your motherboard and we will determine how to fix it. We are more than happy to provide the perfect Samsung repairs and services in Brisbane!

Samsung LCD repair and replacement, Does your LCD does not turn on? No need to worry! Our experts at Computer Repairs Stretton will have your Samsung LCD screen repaired in no time.

Samsung backlight replacement and repair, A broken backlight can ruin the display of your Samsung computer. It might be time for a new backlight. Our workshop has all the genuine parts for Samsung laptops for faster replacement and repair service turnaround.

Samsung laptop keyboard repair and replacement, Accidentally spilled some liquid on your laptop’s keyboard? Keys suddenly stops functioning? We can help you replace your broken laptop keyboard.

Samsung touch-pad replacement, Touch-pad refuses to work? We can fix your touch-pad for you or provide a replacement. We offer nothing but the best and most efficient Samsung repairs in Brisbane.

Samsung inverter repair, Don’t think of having your LCD screen replaced just yet. Let us have your computer checked for possible inverter problems and apply the perfect solution at a very affordable price.

For all your Samsung computer repair needs, call us at 0477 319 160 with no call out fees. Computer Repairs Stretton offers the most affordable computer repair service in Stretton and nearby areas of Brisbane. Our one-stop repair solution focuses not only on hardware problems but also with software issues.

Samsung virus and spyware removal , We rank to be the best among computer virus removal service in Brisbane. Our professional technicians provide expertise in identifying and removal of all known malicious software such as computer worms, ransomware, hijackware, spams, dialers, annoying pop-ups, trojan horses, rootkits, keyloggers, adware, spyware and even malicious Browser Helper Objects (BHOs).

Samsung desktop and laptop upgrades, We offer a wide range of hardware and software upgrades guaranteed to be perfectly compatible for your Samsung computers.

  • PC optimization
  • Hardware installation
  • CPU upgrade
  • RAM upgrade
  • Storage upgrade
  • Computer tune-up
  • Operating system installation and updates
  • Performance speedup
  • Computer reformatting

Samsung internet and network setup, If you are having trouble fixing and configuring your wireless or wired network for your computer, do not hesitate to call Computer Repairs Stretton. We can help you from your email, internet, and Wi-Fi issues up to your complicated intent security problems.

Samsung data and file recovery, We offer a dedicated data and file recovery for each and every computer brands in the market including:

  • Forgotten passwords
  • Data recovery
  • Accidentally deleted file recovery
  • System recovery
  • Formatted drive recovery

Other Samsung hardware repairs

  • Samsung overheating repair
  • Samsung laptop is not turning on
  • Samsung LCD screen is very dim/dark
  • Display only visible external monitor but not visible on Samsung laptop screen
  • Samsung laptop LCD screen is not turning on
  • Samsung laptop LCD screen is cracked
  • Samsung laptop GPU or graphic card problem and distorted display
  • Samsung laptop motherboard malfunction or failure
  • Samsung laptop power supply repairs
  • Samsung loose or broken hinge replacement
  • Samsung LED and CCDL bulb replacement
  • Samsung laptop optical drive upgrade and replacement (DVD-RW, DVD Burners)
  • Samsung AC/DC power jack repairs
  • Samsung replacement of broken or cracked plastic parts (Base cover and LCD cover)
  • Samsung liquid spill repairs (Cola, Water, Coffee, Tea, Wine, etc.)
  • Samsung internal dust and particles cleaning
  • Samsung component level motherboard repairs

Other Samsung software repairs

  • Samsung laptop driver installation
  • Solutions and repairs for Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) and freezing symptoms of Samsung computer
  • Solutions for slow working Samsung laptops
  • Transfer of data
  • Samsung laptop data and file backup services

Custom built Samsung computer, Nothing beats having your very own computer built and customized for your specific needs. All you need to do is give us the right specifications and we will have a custom computer built for you.

How to easily avail our services

Visit our workshop, You are always welcome to visit our workshop and conveniently bring your computer system to us and have our expert technician diagnose your machine to find the problem. Our workshop is open 7 days a week from 7am up to 10pm and even on holidays. We recommend that you give us a courtesy call at 0477 319 160 so we can have your repair service scheduled.

Onsite service, Not so sure about bringing your computer to us? You don’t have to! Our experts can bring their services to your home or residence. Free of call out fees and travel costs.

Remote services, Did you know that almost all software and network repairs can actually be done remotely? That means all you need to do is download a special software and we will be able to access your computer with your permission and fix your computer problems with no additional charges.
